name: anchored-dropdown-radix
title: Anchored Dropdown (Radix)
description: A plus button that pours a multi-select dropdown out of itself, hanging above it: gooey SVG liquid, springs, a travelling hover and a glyph that spins into a tick. Press and drag to pull a liquid finger.
author: arknow91 <https://github.com/arknow91>
docs:
Installed `AnchoredDropdown` in `components/ui/` with its stylesheet, glyphs, menu wiring, row hover and tick burst next to it, and the shared engine (`liquid-taffy-engine`, in `lib/`) as a dependency; install one engine for all three liquid surfaces.

```tsx
import { AnchoredDropdown } from "@/components/ui/anchored-dropdown";

<AnchoredDropdown onValueChange={(ids) => console.log(ids)} />
```

The button stays put and pours the dropdown out of itself, 14px above it. It is a 32px circle: place it with `className` and leave room around it for the panel. Rows are multi-select. It follows the page's theme (a `.dark` ancestor makes it dark) or the `theme` prop; the palette is the `--anchored-dropdown-*` variables. Sound is off unless you pass `sound`.

The `-icons-lucide` and `-icons-phosphor` items draw the plus, the shapes and the tick from an icon library instead of the component's own glyphs.

Press and hold the button or the panel and drag: a liquid finger stretches out of the edge and snaps back on release.

The `-radix`, `-base` and `-aria` items build the same component on Radix's DropdownMenu, Base UI's Menu or React Aria's Menu (same props, same look); the default item writes the WAI-ARIA menu button pattern itself and needs none of them.

Ported from liquid-taffy by arknow91 (MIT); the license notice is at the end of every file.
